# Contributing

Bug reports, themes and fixes are welcome. Check [SCOPE.md](../SCOPE.md) for what fits in prismantis and what to ask about first.

The house rules, layout, verify loop and Mod API gotchas live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), for people and agents alike.

## First-time contributors

Expect your first issue or PR to be answered by the automated maintainer, which says so in its reply. It triages, reviews and merges within the gates in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). If you want a human, say so in the thread or ask for the 
eeds-owner label; the owner answers there.
